en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an interior chapel or side aisle in a historic church or cathedral. The image centers on a stone doorway framed by classical columns and an ornate entablature. Above the doorway is a sculpted relief of the Pietà (the Virgin Mary holding the body of Christ, with other figures) set within an architectural frame. Latin text is inscribed above the relief. The vaulted walls are decorated with draped, carved swags, and there is a simple metal railing in the foreground. Handwritten marks or numbers appear near the lower corners of the image.
